# Annotator agreement on the dev gold graphs (#37)

<!-- Generated by scripts/score_adjudication.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Run 2026-11-08. Worksheets: deepti, varun.

Each annotator labelled **every** gold edge independently, from a sheet carrying
the span and the two variables and no label. Agreement with the machine draft is
a separate section below and is **not** an agreement measurement.

## deepti vs varun

| dimension | items | raw agreement | chance | kappa | 95% interval |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| asserts | 20 | 0.800 | 0.740 | **0.231** | -0.443 to 0.905 |
| direction | 15 | 1.000 | 1.000 | **n/a** | n/a |
| strength | 15 | 1.000 | 0.502 | **1.000** | 1.000 to 1.000 |

- **asserts: high raw agreement with a low kappa.** One label dominates, so chance agreement is close to the observed agreement and kappa collapses. The annotators did agree on nearly every item. Quote the raw agreement (0.800) next to the kappa, never the kappa alone.

- **direction.** 5 of 20 item(s) excluded: at least one annotator said the span asserts no relation, so there is no label to compare

- **direction: kappa undefined.** Both annotators used a single label throughout, so chance agreement is 1. That is a property of the sample, not a failure to agree.

- **strength.** 5 of 20 item(s) excluded: at least one annotator said the span asserts no relation, so there is no label to compare

## Against the machine draft

Not agreement. This is how good the draft was.

| annotator | edges kept | direction matches draft | strength matches draft | edges dropped |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| deepti | 15 | 1.000 | 1.000 | 0.200 |
| varun | 15 | 1.000 | 1.000 | 0.100 |

A low strength-match figure is the expected outcome, not an error: the draft set strength from cue words and the annotator reads the sentence.

## Reading this

The dev gold set is 16 edges, a small sample for a kappa. The widest 95% interval in this run spans **1.35** on a scale that only runs from -1 to 1, so quote the interval rather than the point estimate and do not set these figures beside published kappas from thousand-item corpora.

The pre-declared threshold for usable labels is **kappa ≥ 0.6** on the `asserts` and `direction` dimensions. Below that the annotation guide needs work before the labels are used, and `strength` falls back to the declared direct-vs-hedged collapse (`eval.agreement.strength_agreement`).

Lowest kappa in this run: **0.231** (below the 0.6 threshold).
